rationale.complete: Round 1 done on 25 non-reserved regime-III units (10 testable) plus 3 chat-mode O2 periods: dated period predictions, synthetic validation on 4 real skeletons (6 worlds, 100 runs) and a 12-unit power pool, Amendment A1 before data, both embedding models and 6 estimator variants, surrogate and permutation nulls, natives NE41 and #51 timer wakes, 478 estimate rows. No confirm script (failed card).
rationale.faithfulness: HH383's self-weight law fails its pre-set kill with power 1.00 (pooled w1 -0.01 [-0.12, 0.10]); the read-weight part replicates H113 (a 0.22). The registered estimator could not separate a well or a field from HH383; A1 fixed most of that before data. C 1, D 1, E 1, F 1, H 1.
rationale.usefulness: A clear negative for operators: context composition is not a lever on how much an agent sticks to itself; batch size is (k^0.22).

one_line: Context self-share does not set the self-weight (pooled w1 -0.01 [-0.12, 0.10], power 1.00); the read weight is sublinear, a 0.22 [0.13, 0.31].

models.note: DeGroot self-weight = context share killed; linear read update with k^0.22 weight holds
Kinetic update on the call clock fits the read term; the self-term is set outside the context
Read-out channel sublinear, as in H113

v2.claim: In regime III the weight of an agent's own recent content in its next statement does not rise with its context self-share (pooled w1 -0.01 [-0.12, 0.10], 25 units, power 1.00 at 0.5); read weight grows as k^0.22 [0.13, 0.31]
